answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before its attestations count toward reputation. When independent reviewers prove that two identities share the same controller, the protocol slashes both bonds and redistributes the stake to reviewers. A Sybil operator must therefore lock capital for each identity and risks losing it, making a voyage of cheap account creation costly even across a dune of throwaway wallets; earned reputation becomes a relic only after costly, distinct participation.
